title: Short exact rows for the unrestricted relative cover comparison
statement: Assume derived categories of module sheaves on all schemes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X form a cartesian square. Let K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_X′), φ:Lg′*K→K′ [def-pc-derived-pullback], and U,V opens of X with U∪V=X. Put a=relativeMVGlobalArrow and b(W)=relativeMVLocalArrow using the pinned maps [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. There are short exact short complexes P,P′ of cochain complexes of O_S′-modules, a morphism m:P→P′, and six isomorphisms e_i,e_i′ from Q(P.X_i),Q(P′.X_i) to respectively a.left/right, b(U).left/right⊕b(V).left/right, and b(U∩V).left/right. Under these identifications, Q(m.τ₁) is a.hom, the U and V projections of Q(m.τ₂) are respectively the source projections followed by b(U).hom and b(V).hom, and Q(m.τ₃) is b(U∩V).hom. No cone object or cone map is asserted. No affine, compactness, flatness or quasi-coherence hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Obtain a strict chain square with six vertex comparisons and all three component equations from the resolved geometric cover construction.

Apply the functorial mapping-cylinder presentation retaining the middle component as well as the endpoint and cone components. Compose its six isomorphisms with the geometric comparisons. Transport the first and third component equalities by composition. Compose the middle equality with the two biproduct projections to get the required U and V identities.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMV_cover_rows
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let a := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let b := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (P P' : ShortComplex (CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ))
      (m : P ⟶ P')
      (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₁ ≅ a.left)
      (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₂ ≅ (b U).left ⊞ (b V).left)
      (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₃ ≅ (b (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₁ ≅ a.right)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₂ ≅ (b U).right ⊞ (b V).right)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₃ ≅ (b (U ⊓ V)).right),
      P.ShortExact ∧ P'.ShortExact ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₁ ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ a.hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₂ ≫ e₂'.hom ≫ biprod.fst =
        e₂.hom ≫ biprod.fst ≫ (b U).hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₂ ≫ e₂'.hom ≫ biprod.snd =
        e₂.hom ≫ biprod.snd ≫ (b V).hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₃ ≫ e₃'.hom = e₃.hom ≫ (b (U ⊓ V)).hom
